exposure: Planned repeat low transverse cesarean section (RLTCS)
outcome: Composite maternal adverse outcomes (CMAO) including ICU admission, uterine rupture, unplanned hysterectomy, or maternal blood transfusion
cohort: 794,278 obese patients with prior cesarean birth giving birth at term (≥ 37 weeks estimated gestational age) from the National Birth Certificate database (2016-2020)
finding: Obese patients who underwent TOLAC had a significantly higher overall CMAO compared to those who had a planned RLTCS (9.0 per 1000 live births vs. 5.3 per 1000 live births; aRR 1.64, 95% CI 1.53-1.75).
